lastSummary: NC-032 fixed: No VS Code Extension Host integration tests. (1) Installed @vscode/test-electron, @vscode/test-cli, mocha, @types/mocha as devDependencies in extension/. (10) Updated extension/tsconfig.json to exclude src/test from main compilation. (11) Added build:test, test:integration, test:integration:cli scripts to extension/package.json. (12) 46/46 integration tests pass in VS Code Extension Development Host. (13) 1911/1911 unit tests pass. (14) Build clean. All type-checks clean.
